E1.claim: Larger light radius gives softer shadows
E1.measure: pixels of partial shadow along a scanline across the shadow edge

E2.claim: +1 stop of exposure doubles pixel values
E2.measure: mean pixel value under the Raw view at exposure 0 and +1

E3.claim: AgX desaturates over-exposed colours; Standard clips them at full saturation
E3.measure: mean saturation of the brightest quarter of an over-lit red ball

E4.claim: Default sky texture is too bright at exposure 0 and needs negative exposure
E4.measure: median brightness and clipped fraction at exposure 0, -2 and -4 stops
